sloka: निर्जगम नृपावासान्मन्यमानः प्रियं महत् ।प्रसन्नो राजमार्गं च पताकाध्वजशोभितम् ॥२-१५-२९॥
transliteration: nirjagama nṛpāvāsānmanyamānaḥ priyaṁ mahat ।prasanno rājamārgaṁ ca patākādhvajaśobhitam ॥2-15-29॥

translations.english: The charioteer left cheerfully, happily looking at the highway bedecked with pennants and banners.
